scope: aggregate only; not a fixed migration selection or production datasource attestation

queries.walletCurrencies: SELECT currency, COUNT(*) FROM economy_account GROUP BY currency
queries.skillOrderStates: SELECT status, COUNT(*) FROM economy_skill_order GROUP BY status
queries.hostingStates: SELECT status, COUNT(*) FROM economy_hosting_lease GROUP BY status
queries.taskStates: SELECT reward_status, COUNT(*) FROM agent_task_meta GROUP BY reward_status
queries.missingTaskScope: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM agent_task_meta WHERE tenant_id IS NULL OR client_id IS NULL OR owner_jiacn IS NULL OR tenant_id='' OR client_id='' OR owner_jiacn=''
queries.assignedFacts: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM agent_task_meta m WHERE m.reward_status IN ('assigned','running','reviewing','blocked','failed','completed') OR m.assigned_agent_id IS NOT NULL OR m.assigned_at IS NOT NULL OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM agent_task_execution_grant g WHERE g.tenant_id=m.tenant_id AND g.client_id=m.client_id AND g.owner_jiacn=m.owner_jiacn AND g.task_id=m.task_id) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM agent_task_member x WHERE x.tenant_id=m.tenant_id AND x.client_id=m.client_id AND x.owner_jiacn=m.owner_jiacn AND x.task_id=m.task_id AND x.member_status IN ('accepted','left','completed'))
